spec:
Introduce a Git-tracked test plan (path and schema decided in design) recording each test file's purpose, originating goal id and latest successful input hashes, and let checks.run (or a custom node before it) select only tests whose dependencies changed, using a pinned structural dependency graph (Graft was the reviewed choice). Unknown or unresolved dependencies widen to the full suite; a full-suite mode remains. Results stay bound to the implement tree identity, so a skipped test is justified by recorded hashes. Changed vs old wording: integrates with checks.run and test_design.commands instead of old phase evidence; CI remains the authority at integrate.

Migrated from GitHub issue #557 after the engine reset (#740).
- This PR edits docs/design/SPEC.md and DESIGN.md for every contract change it makes and adds a HISTORY §4 row.
title: Maintain a tracked test plan for affected-test selection in run_tests
